title: Nemotron LoRA SFT v2 Trained Adapter
subtitle: LoRA adapter from nemotron-lora-sft-v2 (Fix A reasoning, LB 0.54)
description: LoRA adapter weights from the v2 SFT training run on 750 stratified solver-generated examples with Fix A reasoning (explicit per-example arithmetic chain-of-thought). Base model: metric/nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b-bf16. Public leaderboard score: 0.54 (vs v1 0.51, untrained baseline 0.50). Saved here so downstream eval kernels can load the adapter without re-training.
